Instrument (EN): Future Orientation Scale — six-item multi-cohort psychometric evaluation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Overall future orientation (one validated common factor); conceptual content: positive future expectations, reasons to persevere and perceived ability to cope/pursue goals; NOT three independently scored subscales.
Research provenance: Altier HR, Sirois FM, Jeglic EL, Hirsch JK. Assessment, first online 2026-06-24, DOI 10.1177/10731911261451782 (PMID 42343154). 3 cross-population cohorts: university undergraduates N3219, fibromyalgia N508, sexual/gender-minority respondents N496 (sum N4223). EFA one factor, CFA fit each group; multi-group configural/metric/scalar measurement invariance supported. Evaluation of a pre-existing scale; do not call a novel 2026 translation or imply new instrument creation.
